_: SRD 5.2.1 SHOULD spells, levels 4 to 9 (docs/v1_spell_list.md), CC-BY-4.0. Ranges are in squares: one square is five feet. A spell marked 'approximated' never ships under its SRD name.

effects.note: SRD 5.2.1: a 20-foot square of tentacles, difficult terrain
SRD 5.2.1: whoever is there when it appears, enters it, or ends its turn there makes a Str save (once per turn): 3d6 bludgeoning and Restrained
an action and a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell's DC breaks free

SRD 5.2.1: a Plant creature automatically fails the save, and a nonmagical plant that is not a creature simply withers. v1 statblocks carry no creature type yet (same flag as the construct rider in level_2.json); the withering plant is narration
SRD 5.2.1: for 8 hours (until the next long rest), the first drop to 0 HP is a drop to 1 instead, and an instant kill that deals no damage is negated; either ends the spell
SRD 5.2.1: the ground is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn

proposed name: Borrowed Form. SRD 5.2.1: a creature (Wis save if unwilling) becomes a Beast of CR no higher than its level or CR, takes that stat block, and gains temporary HP equal to the form's HP; it ends when those are gone. v1 plans curated form cards (v1_spell_list.md) and has no stat-block swap and no hostile use; until the cards exist it grants a placeholder 30 temporary HP standing in for a form's HP
SRD 5.2.1: on a failed save only, another 5d4 acid at the end of the target's next turn
SRD 5.2.1: a 20-foot-radius sphere of heavily obscuring poison fog that moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns
when it appears, when it moves over a creature, when a creature enters it or ends its turn there - once per turn: 5d8 poison, Con save for half
SRD 5.2.1: a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder; one Dex save covers the fire and the radiant, and both grow 1d6 per slot level above 5

proposed name: Rekindled Life. SRD 5.2.1: a 1-hour casting (500 gp diamond, consumed) returns a creature dead no more than 10 days, not undead, with 1 HP, neutralizes poisons and closes mortal wounds; the target takes -4 on D20 Tests, reduced by 1 each long rest. v1 has no hour-long casting time and no penalty that shrinks per rest, so the -4 lasts until the next rest and then ends. The 10-day and undead limits are the campaign's to enforce
SRD 5.2.1: -4 to D20 Tests, reduced by 1 each time the target finishes a long rest

SRD 5.2.1: when cast and as a Magic action later: a Huge or smaller creature makes a Str save or is moved up to 30 feet within range and Restrained until the end of your next turn. lifting it into the air is the narrator's (no altitude on the board)
SRD 5.2.1: an object a creature holds - your spellcasting ability check against its Strength check pulls it away, up to 30 feet. moving unattended objects and fine control are the narrator's

SRD 5.2.1: a wall of whirling blades up to 100 feet long, or a ring 60 feet across, 5 feet thick: three-quarters cover (+5 AC and Dex saves) to whoever is behind it, and its space is difficult terrain
a creature in the wall's space when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there makes a Dex save (once per turn): 6d10 slashing, half on a success

SRD 5.2.1: Con save or Restrained; it saves again at the end of each of its turns, three successes end the spell and three failures (the first save counts) Petrify it for the duration. a Construct succeeds automatically. the permanence of a full minute held is the campaign's: a fight ends before it
SRD 5.2.1: on a successful save, Speed 0 until the start of the caster's next turn
SRD 5.2.1: an immobile 10-foot barrier around where you stand; a spell of level 5 or lower (one higher per slot level above 6) cast from outside cannot affect anything inside
SRD 5.2.1: Truesight 120 feet for 1 hour - sees the Invisible and through magical darkness on the board; seeing through illusions, shapechanges and into the Ethereal is the narrator's

SRD 5.2.1: an immobile cage of force bars 20 feet on a side for an hour: nothing inside walks out, but it can be seen and shot through. no save. magical travel out needs a Cha save. Dispel Magic cannot end it. the 1,500 gp ruby dust is not tracked (no v1 spell tracks costly components)
or a solid box 10 feet on a side that nothing passes through - not sight, not spells

proposed name: Worldwalk. SRD 5.2.1: the caster and up to eight willing creatures linking hands go to another plane (a tuning fork attuned to it); or a melee spell attack then a Cha save banishes an unwilling creature. v1 travels to a campaign-authored place only, and the banishing use - removing a creature from the fight - has no primitive

proposed name: Skyward Fall. SRD 5.2.1: in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder everything falls upward (a Dex save grabs something fixed), takes falling damage on a ceiling, hangs at the top, and falls back down when the spell ends. v1 has no altitude or falling damage, so the ones who fly up are Restrained for concentration

proposed name: Null Sphere. SRD 5.2.1: a 10-foot emanation that suppresses (does not end) spells, magic items, magical attacks and summoned creatures inside it, the caster included, for as long as they are inside. v1 has no suppression, so it dispels what is around the caster when cast and marks the field

proposed name: Rending Quake. SRD 5.2.1: a 100-foot-radius tremor; when cast and at the end of each of the caster's turns, creatures on the ground make a Dex save or fall Prone, concentrators make a Con save or lose it, fissures open and swallow, structures take 50 bludgeoning and may collapse, and the ground is difficult terrain. v1 re-shakes only when the caster spends an action (not free at turn end), and has no concentration-breaking, fissures, structure damage or difficult terrain (v1_spell_list.md: hazard pulses and authored destructible tags)

proposed name: Labyrinth Exile. SRD 5.2.1: no save; the target is banished into a labyrinthine demiplane and can take a Study action for a DC 20 Int (Investigation) check to escape, reappearing where it left. v1 leaves the mini on the board marked out of the fight (as banishment does) and has no escape check
SRD 5.2.1: no save; a target with 150 HP or fewer is Stunned and makes a Con save at the end of each of its turns to end it
SRD 5.2.1: a tougher target instead has a Speed of 0 until the start of the caster's next turn
SRD 5.2.1: advantage on D20 tests, and attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage, for eight hours

proposed name: Myriad Forms. SRD 5.2.1: the caster becomes any creature of CR up to their level they have seen, takes its stat block (keeping mental scores, class features and spellcasting), gains temporary HP equal to the form's HP, and can switch form as a bonus action. v1 plans curated high-level form cards with one swap per turn (v1_spell_list.md); until they exist it grants a placeholder 100 temporary HP standing in for a form's HP

proposed name: Perfect Remaking. SRD 5.2.1: turn a creature into another creature or an object, or an object into a creature (Wis save if unwilling); new stat block and form HP; permanent if concentration lasts the full hour. v1 has no stat-block swap; here only the hostile use exists - turned into an object, the target is out of the fight for concentration. Allied forms and permanence belong to curated forms and authored hooks (v1_spell_list.md)
